build_sun397_dataset_builder: build a tfds GeneratorBasedBuilder for the SUN397 scene recognition dataset with configurable splits and image processing
create_sun397_builder_config: create a Sun397Config builder config with target pixels, partition number, and JPEG quality settings
generate_builder_configs: generate tfds BuilderConfig objects for all SUN397 standard partitions and the default tfds split
process_image_file: process a SUN397 image file by decoding multi-format images, resizing to target pixels, and encoding as JPEG
split_sun397_dataset: split the SUN397 dataset into train, validation, and test splits using official partitions or random tfds splits
